summary_en: BCPE Neon Cayman LP launched tender offer for all ordinary shares and outstanding warrants (2nd–7th tranches) of Baudroie at ¥3,600 per share. Tender period: 31 business days (19 Aug – 5 Oct 2026). Warrants to be acquired at prices to be determined separately. Treasury shares excluded.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer by BCPE Neon Cayman LP for Baudroie, Inc. (Securities Code: 4413)
translation_en_brief: BCPE Neon Cayman LP, a Cayman-registered investment fund, commenced a tender offer on 19 August 2026 to acquire all ordinary shares and outstanding warrant series (2nd through 7th tranches, issued between February 2020 and May 2026) of Baudroie, Inc., a Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market–listed company. The tender price is ¥3,600 per ordinary share. Warrant purchase prices are to be determined separately. The offer period runs for 31 business days, from 19 August through 5 October 2026. Treasury shares held by Baudroie are excluded from the offer. The filing does not disclose the total number of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), the aggregate yen amount authorized for acquisition, or acceptance thresholds at this stage.
